description: This file defines a React component for a virtualized list container with features like item rendering, group headers, selection, and scrolling, used within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: CustomScrollbarsVirtualList
methods.description: A React component that wraps ScrollContainer with forwarded ref for custom scrollbars.

methods.name: ListContainer
methods.description: Main React component rendering a virtualized list with grouping, selection, and scrolling features.

methods.name: ItemRenderer
methods.description: Renders individual list items or placeholders during loading.

methods.name: VirtuosoItem
methods.description: Wraps list items to handle mouse events for selection.

methods.name: ListHeader
methods.description: Renders the list header or default announcements.

methods.name: waitForElement
methods.description: Scrolls an element into view and waits until it is rendered into the DOM.
